question: If the radius of a sphere is increased by 37.5%, its surface area is increased by 35,112 cm². Find the original surface area of the sphere. (Take pi = (22)/(7) )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface area ∝ r²

Radius increases by 37.5% = 3/8 ⇒ new radius = 11/8 of original

New area factor = (11/8)² = 121/64

Increase = (121/64 − 1) = 57/64 of original

**∴ Original area = 35112 × (64/57) = 39424**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Increase in radius = 37.5% and increase in surface area = 35112 cm²

**Formula used:**

Surface area of sphere = 4πr²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let original radius = r

⇒ New radius = 1.375r = 11r/8

⇒ Original area = 4πr²

⇒ New area = 4π(11r/8)² = 4πr² × (121/64)

⇒ Increase = 4πr² (121/64 − 1)

⇒ = 4πr² × (57/64)

⇒ Let original area = S

⇒ Increase = S × (57/64) = 35112

⇒ S = 35112 × (64/57)

⇒ S = 39424

**∴ The correct answer is 39424 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Sphere

Surface area = 4πr²

Percentage Increase in Radius

If radius increases by x%, new radius = r(1 + x/100)

Area Relation

Area depends on square of radius ⇒ change factor = (new/old)²

Quick Ratio Trick

If radius changes in ratio a:b, area changes in ratio a²:b²
